PRESTO enrols 2 or more moderate or 1 or more severe exacerbations in the prior 12 months on stable dual or triple inhaled therapy, with no eosinophil criterion (NCT07082738). That is the all-eosinophil exacerbating pool tozorakimab carries: GSK states that approximately 70% of US COPD patients inadequately controlled on inhaled triple therapy who continue to exacerbate have a blood eosinophil count of 150 cells/uL and above, over a million people (6-K 0001654954-25-006056, Nucala COPD approval, 22 May 2025). All eosinophil counts are 1,000,000 / 0.70 = 1,428,571, and 1,428,571 / 14,200,000 = 0.1006. It equals tozorakimab's row so the two share one pool.
